mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super / Counter Skill obtained through the Shenron "I want a new Super Attack!" route. The user creates a lens-like barrier for about one second, receives protection/Super Armor while it is active, then fires a single Ki wave; current skill documentation reports about 10% damage. Exact frame and interaction behavior remain unresolved.
evidence_limits: Exact frames/timing/tracking, patch-independent damage values, and unresolved reward probabilities or gates are not promoted without direct support.
